items.prompt: QUALITY_GATE:CLEAN_COMMERCIAL. Premium Korean fashion-commerce hero, wide 4:3 composition with generous copy-safe space on the left. Keep the same Korean woman in her 20s from Image 4, natural straight dark hair and calm modern identity. Images 1, 2 and 3 are the exact real SALLANG loose-fit cool sleeve SSOT. She wears exactly two matching white sleeves, one on each arm, in a warm-ivory studio with a pale-sky floor and one cobalt architectural curve. Show both arms from below the shoulders through the fingertips so the real long approximately 47 cm impression is obvious. Each sleeve has one flat gathered upper-arm band forming a clean horizontal ring, a long loose tube with irregular fine vertical pleats, a wide hand-back cuff, a natural side thumb opening and a small label on the back-of-hand cuff. Critical invariant: no diagonal spiral folds, no crossed pleat bands, no rope twist, no braided upper section, no X overlap, no tight sports fit. Two normal hands, five fingers each. No text overlay, no logo invention, no props covering the product.

QUALITY_GATE:CLEAN_COMMERCIAL. Premium close commercial proof of loose fit, wide 4:3. Same Korean woman in her 20s, one right arm extended gently downward against a warm-ivory background. Recreate exactly one real white SALLANG sleeve from Images 1 to 3: flat gathered upper band below shoulder, long airy tube, irregular fine pleats running generally vertically, visible gentle loose volume around the arm, wide cuff covering the back of the hand, natural thumb opening and label on hand-back cuff. The upper band must be a single flat ring and the body must not show any diagonal spiral seam, crossed ribbon, braid or rope twist. Shoulder to fingertips fully visible. No text, no extra garment, no tight compression silhouette.

QUALITY_GATE:CLEAN_COMMERCIAL. Premium hand-cover proof macro, wide 4:3 with empty copy space. Use Images 1 to 3 as exact real product SSOT. One natural female hand wears exactly one real white SALLANG sleeve. Show the wide cuff lying over the back of the hand, thumb naturally through the small side opening, fingers free, and the small two-line label lying low and flat on the back-of-hand cuff. The long loose vertically pleated tube continues up the forearm and exits frame without twisting. Preserve real seam spacing and true white translucency. Five fingers, no glove shape, no giant thumb hole, no duplicate label, no text overlay.

QUALITY_GATE:CLEAN_COMMERCIAL. Premium summer cool-material campaign still, wide 4:3. Same Korean woman in her 20s from Image 4 wears exactly one real white SALLANG loose-fit sleeve on her right arm in a bright ivory studio. Keep the full shoulder-to-fingertips length, one flat upper band, loose vertical irregular pleats, wide hand-back cuff, natural thumb opening and label on hand-back cuff. A restrained environmental color transition moves from soft warm coral far behind her to pale cool blue around the sleeve, suggesting a cooler direction without thermal-camera effects or numbers. No snowflakes, no thermometer, no temperature scale, no test result, no diagonal product twist, no text.
